text: Santa has one night to deliver every present.
But what if he flew so fast that time itself began to bend?
Einstein showed that the faster you move, the slower your clock ticks.
Fly close enough to the speed of light, and one night for you can be years for everyone else.
At home, nobody is moving. Their clocks run normally.
Every second on his watch is nine hours here.
He spends three seconds in a child's living room.
Back home, more than a day goes by.
He lands at six in the morning. Right on time.
But the house has waited through twenty-three Christmases.
